author: Stormy7s
quote: The Greatest game of all time i played the first time in 2017 after Playing the legend of zelda breath of the wild since I liked it too much and many zelda fans recommended me this game And I cant believe How many times I played it now, everything in this game is peak dungeons, bosses and the atmosphere of the game in general and This is something I think modern games sometimes struggle with. Ocarina understands that atmosphere isn't just graphics. It's sound design, architecture, lighting, music and silence working together. The seven-year time skip is one of the greatest narrative decisions in gaming catching the feeling of a child who sacrificed his innocence to save the world. The game is peak Just play it man !
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)

author: Stormy7s

The graphics is peak even tho it wasn't as good as the trailer but it's quite understandable probably will be way better on pc.
